name: Binghatti Nova
paymentPlan: 20% down at sales launch, 40% during construction, 40% on handover
overview: Binghatti Nova is the embodiment of luxury and convenience, a new residential development situated within the Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) in Dubai brought to you by Binghatti Developers FZE. The project's main highlights include its modern design, quality amenities, and its strategic location. Boasting of 1 & 2 bedroom apartments, each unit stands as a testament to Binghatti Developers' commitment to providing residents with an elevated standard of living.
